summary: For jobs stuck in pending, list them with awx-manage shell_plus and UnifiedJob.objects.filter(status='pending'), then cancel all with .update(status='canceled') or one by filtering on id.
questions: How do I cancel jobs stuck in pending in automation controller?
How do I list pending jobs from the controller shell?
Why are my controller jobs stuck in pending?

answer_card.title: Cancel jobs stuck in pending
answer_card.answer_md:
```bash
awx-manage shell_plus
```
```python
>>> UnifiedJob.objects.filter(status='pending')            # list
>>> UnifiedJob.objects.filter(status='pending').update(status='canceled')  # cancel all
>>> UnifiedJob.objects.filter(id=<job_id>).update(status='canceled')       # cancel one
```
See "Playbook stays in pending" in Configuring automation execution for root causes.
